# Awesome Jev Projects — Full Catalog (llms-full.txt)
> Total Vetted Projects: 259
> Canonical URL: https://logicrw.github.io/awesome-jev-projects/
> Repository: https://github.com/logicrw/awesome-jev-projects

Jev (by TypeSafe AI) is a specialized low-latency decision model designed for structured, sub-100ms System-One choices in autonomous agent loops.

---

### jev-ultrafast
- Repository: https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast
- Category: Browser & OS Action
- Overview (EN): Ultra-fast browser agent using Jev for per-step DOM action decisions. Complete Google Flights search in ~7.1s.
- Overview (ZH): 给浏览器一个目标，Jev 负责选按钮和动作，文字交给小模型写。作者的 Google Flights 示例约 7.1 秒完成。
- Jev Decision Role: 读当前 DOM，在一次请求里选择操作和目标元素；需要输入时才调用文本模型。
- Core Benefit: 把界面选择与文字生成分开，减少重复读页面。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: Author test: one flight task, three runs per setup; median time fell from 9.450 to 7.092 seconds. This is not a general agent benchmark. Not independently retested by this site.

### typesafe-mcp
- Repository: https://github.com/itsmostafa/typesafe-mcp
- Category: MCP & Integrations
- Overview (EN): MCP server connecting Jev directly into Claude Code, Claude Desktop, and Codex as a decision co-processor.
- Overview (ZH): 给 Claude Code、Claude Desktop 和 Codex 接上一个选择题外脑：选哪个、打几分、是不是，都用同一个 MCP 工具问。
- Jev Decision Role: 把状态和 typed questions 交给 Jev，返回 Choice、Score、Noul 及概率。
- Core Benefit: 拿到可以直接写进分支判断的答案，省去解析一大段文字。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: The README covers the interface and client setup; no millisecond-scale end-to-end test was found for this project. Not independently retested by this site.

### jev-mcp
- Repository: https://github.com/jkudish/jev-mcp
- Category: MCP & Integrations
- Overview (EN): Pragmatic MCP utility suite packaging real-time fact-checking, prompt injection guards, and semantic reranking.
- Overview (ZH): 给 Agent 配三个小助手：核对引用、筛查注入指令、从候选里挑出相关结果。
- Jev Decision Role: 通过 verify、screen、find 分别给证据支持度、内容风险和候选相关性做判断。
- Core Benefit: 让每次读取和引用都能加一道可配置的检查。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: The author reports about 150–500 ms. Typed output does not guarantee factual accuracy, and thresholds need calibration. Not independently retested by this site.

### SemDecide
- Repository: https://github.com/sharziki/semdecide
- Category: CLI & Pipelines
- Overview (EN): Unix command-line utility bringing Jev into terminal pipes and CI pipelines for semantic filtering and scoring.
- Overview (ZH): 给终端管道加一点语义判断：一句话分类、一批文本过滤，都能接在 Bash 和 CI 后面。
- Jev Decision Role: 对输入做分类或概率判断，再由本地规则执行阈值、退出码与 allow/escalate/block。
- Core Benefit: 不用搭一个完整 Agent，也能把语义判断嵌进现有脚本。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: The README describes the CLI; its behavior has not been independently verified. Not independently retested by this site.

### Jev Codex Router
- Repository: https://github.com/0xNatoshi/jev-codex-router
- Category: Routing & Cost Optimization
- Overview (EN): Smart request router evaluating turn difficulty with Jev to route between cheap and frontier models.
- Overview (ZH): 每轮先看任务有多难，再给 Codex 选模型和思考深度。简单活省一点，难活再上强模型。
- Jev Decision Role: Jev 判断当前轮次的任务层级与推理需求，本地策略决定模型、effort 和速度档。
- Core Benefit: 作者对 237 轮历史会话按标价重算，估计比全用最贵模型省约 60%。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: The 60% figure is a list-price estimate from one person’s session replay with fixed token counts; it excludes cache invalidation across models. It is not a reduction in a paid bill. Not independently retested by this site.

### Winnow
- Repository: https://github.com/GhalebDweikat/winnow
- Category: Context GC & Filter
- Overview (EN): Context garbage collector for Claude Code pruning voluminous bash, grep, and file outputs.
- Overview (ZH): 给 Claude Code 的长日志装一道筛子。暂时不相关的内容先藏起来，想看时还能完整找回。
- Jev Decision Role: 逐块判断 Read、Bash、Grep 输出是否有用；保留相关或不确定内容，隐藏高置信度无关块。
- Core Benefit: 减少进入上下文的冗余输出，并保留可召回的原文。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: Uses Jev by default and also supports a Haiku adapter. Savings and the risk of hiding useful content depend on the task and thresholds; it does not guarantee a complete fix for context limits. Not independently retested by this site.

### Jev Review
- Repository: https://github.com/devagrawal09/jev-review
- Category: Codebase & Graph Pathfinding
- Overview (EN): Code review triage engine assessing correctness, security, reliability, and compatibility before deep review.
- Overview (ZH): 先给代码变更分诊，再沿着风险线索往下查。结果放在本地面板里，方便逐条看证据。
- Jev Decision Role: 分阶段评估风险、选择文件和证据、判定机制与严重程度，再决定审查路径。
- Core Benefit: 把审查收敛到具体代码片段和风险信号。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: The README supports diff and whole-repository reviews. It does not establish that large models are called only for high risks, and provides no controlled compute-savings result. Not independently retested by this site.

### Blink
- Repository: https://github.com/ellipsis-dev/blink
- Category: Codebase & Graph Pathfinding
- Overview (EN): Semantic pathfinder navigating large codebases without vector indexes using beam search.
- Overview (ZH): 描述你要找的代码，让一群探针顺着目录往下走。看起来越相关的路径，分到的探针越多。
- Jev Decision Role: 给文件和目录名判断相关概率，按概率把 walkers 分配到下一层。
- Core Benefit: 直接沿文件树查找，无需先建立向量索引。
- License: Not specified
- Verified Status: The README calls this an ensemble of walkers, not beam search, and provides no general speed benchmark. Not independently retested by this site.

### neo4jev
- Repository: https://github.com/jexp/neo4jev
- Category: Codebase & Graph Pathfinding
- Overview (EN): Knowledge graph pathfinder scoring candidate edges with Jev and traversing paths via beam search.
- Overview (ZH): 在 Neo4j 里一步步找关系：每到一个节点，就问 Jev 下一条边该往哪走。
- Jev Decision Role: Choice 为相邻关系分配概率，Noul 判断是否到达目标；本地 beam search 保留候选路径。
- Core Benefit: 把自然语言目标接到可查看的图谱路径上。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: A graph-navigation demo; no measurement on tens of millions of nodes or tens-fold speedup was found. Without a key, the docs explicitly use labeled substitute answers. Not independently retested by this site.

### jev-desktop
- Repository: https://github.com/lahfir/agent-desktop
- Category: Browser & OS Action
- Overview (EN): Desktop GUI automation co-processor navigating native accessibility trees to pick next buttons, menus, and controls step-by-step.
- Overview (ZH): 把电脑里的按钮和菜单交给 Jev 来选。它读原生无障碍结构，一步步完成桌面操作。
- Jev Decision Role: Jev 同时选择动作与目标，并评估置信度和操作风险；本地策略决定是否执行或停止。
- Core Benefit: 让主 Agent 不必把整棵界面树塞进上下文。
- License: Apache-2.0
- Verified Status: Jev is integrated through separate skill/scripts in agent-desktop. The docs report about 3 seconds for a complex interface snapshot; this does not establish extremely low overall latency. Not independently retested by this site.

### TypeSafe AI Playground
- Repository: https://github.com/markjaquith/typesafe-ai-playground
- Category: CLI & Pipelines
- Overview (EN): Rust CLI playground experimenting with PHI detection, code comment review, and sentiment classification.
- Overview (ZH): 一个 Rust 实验箱：查隐私信息、看代码注释、判断表达是否友善，直接在终端试 Jev。
- Jev Decision Role: 把短任务拆成概率或类别判断，例如是否含 PHI、注释是否有用、语气是否友善。
- Core Benefit: 用可运行的小实验理解结构化判断能放在哪里。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: The README provides experiment commands; there is no performance evidence for sub-millisecond responses. Not independently retested by this site.

### Prism
- Repository: https://github.com/irfndi/prism-liquidity-agent
- Category: Domain & Vertical Tools
- Overview (EN): DeFi liquidity agent detecting toxic flow, market stress, and pool distribution in shadow mode.
- Overview (ZH): 观察 Solana 流动性池的 Agent。Jev 在旁边给风险打分，先与规则结果对照，不直接决定买卖。
- Jev Decision Role: 对入池分布、毒性交易流、回归持有与市场压力给出影子判断，日志用于校准。
- Core Benefit: 给既有规则多一组可比较的信号；交易决定仍由确定性规则控制。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: engine/jev-service.ts explicitly says shadow/advisory only and NEVER drives ENTER/EXIT. The README describes a 10-minute main loop, not evidence of second-scale quant trading. Not independently retested by this site.

### 1v1 Jev
- Repository: https://github.com/emrickgarrett/OneVOneJev
- Category: High-Frequency & Simulation
- Overview (EN): Real-time 1v1 browser FPS duel where Jev evaluates tick-based battlefield telemetry to decide movement, aim, and firing actions.
- Overview (ZH): 在浏览器里和 Jev 打一局 1v1 射击。它看结构化战况，选走位、瞄准和开火。
- Jev Decision Role: 每个决策 tick 同时询问移动、视角、开镜、开火与跳跃；API 不可用时切到启发式逻辑。
- Core Benefit: 把结构化判断放进持续交互的游戏循环，直观看到决策过程。
- License: Not specified
- Verified Status: The README describes a decision tick of about 9 Hz, not independently measured sustained API throughput. A heuristic fallback is present. Not independently retested by this site.

### Safer with Jev
- Repository: https://github.com/andrelandgraf/typesafe-on-neon
- Category: Security & Guardrails
- Overview (EN): Serverless request router on Neon evaluating incoming queries and dispatching to specialized frontier models.
- Overview (ZH): 给 HTTP 请求装一道内容门禁。Jev 先检查注入指令或不安全内容，通过了再转发到指定地址。
- Jev Decision Role: 检查请求内容是否允许通过；本地代码在 pass 时转发，review 或 block 时拦住。
- Core Benefit: 把内容检查放到上游请求前，直接复用现有 HTTP 服务。
- License: Not specified
- Verified Status: The current README describes a safety gateway, with no evidence of routing models by task difficulty or zero-cold-start performance. Not independently retested by this site.

### fast-jev-compaction
- Repository: https://github.com/tamaratran/fast-jev-compaction
- Category: Context GC & Filter
- Overview (EN): fast-jev-compaction: Prunes extraneous tool outputs, logs, and grep results before feeding LLM context.
- Overview (ZH): 给 Claude Code 压缩上下文时，先删掉过时的工具调用和结果。留下来的原文不改写，关键对话仍按原样保留。
- Jev Decision Role: 分别判断一条工具调用是否还要记住、它的结果是否仍需完整保留；本地规则决定保留、截短或删除。
- Core Benefit: 用原文筛选替代部分摘要，减少路径、报错和命令在改写中走样。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

### jev-review
- Repository: https://github.com/NiazMorshed2007/jev-review
- Category: Codebase & Graph Pathfinding
- Overview (EN): Code review triage engine assessing correctness, security, reliability, and compatibility before deep review.
- Overview (ZH): 给写代码的 Agent 一块质量仪表盘：每改一段，就看看可读性、安全性和测试等维度有没有变好。
- Jev Decision Role: 接收聚焦的代码差异与上下文，用 Score、Choice、Noul 给各质量维度打分，再与上一轮比较。
- Core Benefit: 把每轮修改的质量变化摆出来，帮助主 Agent 决定接下来查哪里。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

### pg-jev
- Repository: https://github.com/realZachi/pg-jev
- Category: Data & Search
- Overview (EN): pg-jev: Semantic query and classification layer applied over tabular databases and search indexes.
- Overview (ZH): 让 SQL 直接问「哪些工单的客户正在生气」。用一句人话给数据库行筛选、分类和排序。
- Jev Decision Role: 把行内容成批交给 Jev，返回是否符合条件、所属类别或等级分数，供 WHERE、GROUP BY、ORDER BY 使用。
- Core Benefit: 语义条件可以和原有 SQL 一起写，并复用同一会话里已经算过的判断。
- License: Not specified
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

### jevpilot
- Repository: https://github.com/standardagents/jevpilot
- Category: High-Frequency & Simulation
- Overview (EN): Autonomous vehicle simulator where Jev selects optimal steering paths and speed profiles from pre-calculated candidate trajectories.
- Overview (ZH): 在浏览器里开一辆小车，让 Jev 从提前算好的路线和速度里选下一步。
- Jev Decision Role: 读取路况、附近车辆和候选轨迹，选择转向与速度；碰撞预测和紧急刹车由代码处理。
- Core Benefit: 把驾驶判断和物理计算拆开，能直接查看每次选择及其概率。
- License: Not specified
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

### jev-browser
- Repository: https://github.com/jkudish/jev-browser
- Category: Browser & OS Action
- Overview (EN): End-to-end browser agent navigating URLs, clicking controls, filling forms, and logging per-step action audit trails.
- Overview (ZH): 给它一个网址和任务，它会选按钮、填字段、翻页面，最后交回页面内容和每一步的操作记录。
- Jev Decision Role: 每步用 Choice 选 DOM 动作，用两个 Noul 判断是否完成或卡住；输入文字交给另一小模型。
- Core Benefit: 通过 MCP、CLI 或库复用同一浏览器循环，并查看动作、恢复过程和错误记录。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

### pi-jev
- Repository: https://github.com/y0usaf/pi-jev
- Category: Security & Guardrails
- Overview (EN): Risk guard for Pi coding agent verifying command boundaries pre-execution and auditing logs post-execution for secret leakage.
- Overview (ZH): 给 Pi 编程助手加一个风险观察员：执行前看命令会不会越界，执行后看日志是否泄露秘密、错误该怎么处理。
- Jev Decision Role: 先判断破坏性、外传、越界和影响，再给输出做秘密检测与错误分类；也提供可直接调用的 jev_ask。
- Core Benefit: 把操作风险和故障类型及时提示给 Agent 与用户。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

### pi-jev-auto-mode
- Repository: https://github.com/jomatsu/pi-jev-auto-mode
- Category: Security & Guardrails
- Overview (EN): Execution gatekeeper for Pi coding agent passing safe commands immediately while routing ambiguous actions to Jev with default-deny policies.
- Overview (ZH): 给 Pi 的命令执行加一道门禁。明确安全的先通过，其余交给 Jev 判断；默认拿不准就拦住。
- Jev Decision Role: 本地规则先处理硬拒绝和允许项，Jev 再检查升级上来的 bash、write、edit 是否符合授权及风险条件。
- Core Benefit: 把常见允许规则与语义检查接起来，保留每次判断记录供调阈值。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

### Jev-Trades
- Repository: https://github.com/zadescoxp/Jev-Trades
- Category: Domain & Vertical Tools
- Overview (EN): High-frequency perp trader on Hyperliquid with live dashboard (jev-trade.com). Evaluates order book every tick to trade.
- Overview (ZH): 用实时加密货币行情练习模拟交易。Jev 给出交易判断，面板展示虚拟仓位和技术指标，不连真实下单接口。
- Jev Decision Role: 读取已完成的分钟 K 线与技术指标，对启用的资产返回结构化交易判断；Python 按置信度和仓位限制更新模拟账户。
- Core Benefit: 把行情、模型信号和模拟持仓放在一起观察，便于检查决策过程。
- License: Apache-2.0
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

### jev
- Repository: https://github.com/dannote/jev
- Category: MCP & Integrations
- Overview (EN): jev: Exposes Jev low-latency decision primitives via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Overview (ZH): 把 Jev 变成 Elixir 程序里的一个异步同伴。发去状态和问题，答案回来后直接用模式匹配决定下一步。
- Jev Decision Role: 把 Noul、Choice、Score 的回复转成 Elixir map，再由 GenServer 的 handle_answer 与 guard 路由。
- Core Benefit: 沿用 OTP 的消息、监督和错误处理方式接入模型判断。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

- Overview (EN): Pragmatic MCP utility suite packaging real-time fact-checking, prompt injection guards, and semantic reranking.

- Jev Decision Role: 将工具参数转成 Jev 的 Choice、Score、Noul 问题，返回结构化答案和概率。
- Core Benefit: Agent 拿到能直接用于分支判断的结果，不用再解析一段回答。

### HA-Jev

- Overview (EN): Home Assistant integration translating household state telemetry into semantic sensors via Jev (e.g. laundry reminders).
- Overview (ZH): 让智能家居回答「衣服是不是洗完却忘了拿」。Jev 的答案变成 Home Assistant 传感器，接进已有自动化。
- Jev Decision Role: 把选定设备和实体的状态交给 Jev，得到概率、选项或分数，再按配置阈值触发自动化。

### jev-benchmarks
- Repository: https://github.com/AbdelStark/jev-benchmarks
- Category: Decision Tools
- Overview (EN): Comparative benchmark contrasting Jev and GLiNER on classification tasks, measuring accuracy alongside probability calibration curves.
- Overview (ZH): 把 Jev 和 GLiNER 放到同一批分类题上，除了答对率，也检查概率靠不靠谱。
- Jev Decision Role: 对固定文本和标签集合做分类，记录每个标签的概率、耗时和失败。
- Core Benefit: 能看清模型在哪些任务上适合自动处理，在哪些任务上容易过度自信。
- License: Apache-2.0
- Verified Status: Distilled automatically from repository metadata and README; decision mechanism categorized by rule and awaiting manual retest. Not independently run or performance-benchmarked by this site.

### Jevbridge
- Repository: https://github.com/gamesonrblx/Jevbridge
- Category: MCP & Integrations
- Overview (EN): Jevbridge: Exposes Jev low-latency decision primitives via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Overview (ZH): 给现有 Agent 接一个结构化决策适配器：同样的问题可以交给 Jev，也可以交给普通模型或离线规则。
- Jev Decision Role: 对状态回答 Choice、Score、Noul，再按置信度把动作建议分成执行、确认、升级或放弃。
- Core Benefit: 统一决策接口，便于试验任务路由、工具门禁和界面动作选择。

### jev-playground

- Overview (EN): MoonBit playground testing Jev on Gomoku board decisions, simplified MOBA unit control, and command risk triage.

- Jev Decision Role: 把棋盘、游戏状态、命令或候选任务转成类型化问题，让 Jev 选动作或给风险评分。
- Core Benefit: 把不同问题的问法、结果和限制放到可重跑的小实验里比较。

### zod-jev
- Repository: https://github.com/jomatsu/zod-jev
- Category: MCP & Integrations
- Overview (EN): zod-jev: Exposes Jev low-latency decision primitives via the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
- Overview (ZH): 给 Zod 表单校验补上「意思对不对」这一层：字段格式过关后，再看描述是否匹配、内容是否含个人信息。
- Jev Decision Role: 把同一次解析的语义规则合并成 Jev Noul 问题，再按概率映射成通过、拒绝、不确定或不可用。

### jevql
- Repository: https://github.com/kylemclaren/jevql
- Category: Data & Search
- Overview (EN): Semantic SQL for vanilla Postgres without database extensions. Query rows with WHERE jev(), jev_prob, jev_choice, and jev_score via CLI and Go/TS/Python SDKs.
- Overview (ZH): 针对原生 Postgres 的 Jev 语义 SQL 扩展。无需装插件，在终端和 Go/TS/Python SDK 中直接用 WHERE jev() 做语义过滤、排序与分组。
- Jev Decision Role: 对 SQL 初筛后的每一行数据调用 Jev 进行 Noul、Choice 或 Score 判断，结果用于客户端的语义过滤、概率排序或分组。

### PiJ
- Repository: https://github.com/tonyzdev/PiJ
- Category: Codebase & Graph Pathfinding
- Overview (EN): A terminal coding agent built on Pi. The coding model handles reasoning, edits, and tool use; Jev provides advisory skill suggestions, reranks source candidates, and triages tool failures while preserving original paths, line numbers, source text, and error output.
- Overview (ZH): 一个基于 Pi 的终端编码 Agent。主模型负责推理、改代码和调用工具；Jev 提供技能建议、源码候选排序和工具失败分流，同时保留原始路径、行号、源码与错误输出。
- Jev Decision Role: 技能建议先用 noul 判断是否需要，再用 choice 选候选并以 noul 复核；pij_search 和可选的 source briefing 用 noul 给真实源码候选排序；工具失败则用 choice 分到代码、环境、依赖、网络、权限或未知，再附固定检查清单。结果均为建议。
- Core Benefit: 把技能筛选、源码候选排序和失败分流交给 Jev 做小判断，同时保留原始证据和本地检查路径；服务不可用时仍可回到普通 coding agent 与字面搜索。
- License: MIT
- Verified Status: Fixed-version source reviewed: Jev outputs are advisory and source briefing is off by default. Inconsistent figures in the author experiments were omitted. This site has not run the project or independently benchmarked it.
